FILTER(lang(?nombre) = 'es') FILTER(regex(str(datatype(?n2)), 'ALPHA_2$')) FILTER(regex(str(datatype(?n3)), 'ALPHA_3$')) BIND(str(?n2) AS ?alfa2) BIND(str(?n3) AS ?alfa3) } ORDER BY ?alfa2
